data.gender_notes: Jundub is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jundub is a praiseworthy and commendable name that reflects the virtues of a noble person. It is derived from the Arabic word 'jundub' meaning praise or commendation. The name Jundub carries the meaning “Praiseworthy, Commendable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jundub usually hope their child will grow to embody praiseworthy, commendable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
